title: Abbahu bar Chanina
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Tanchuma Yashan, Vayetze 3, but Hyman says it should read Rabbi Chanina son of R' Abbahu, as in Midrash Tehillim 91.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The reversal from Abbahu bar Chanina to Chanina son of Abbahu is Hyman’s proposed emendation.

The whole OYW Midrash Tehillim 91 paragraph has Rabbi Chanina bar Abbahu, with no title before the father Abbahu. The complete three-paragraph Buber 1885 Tanchuma Vayetzei 3 selection does not contain the supplied Abbahu/Chanina attribution; this is a bounded nonmatch only. Hyman’s reversal and emphatic “should read” remain his proposed emendation, with R' for the father’s unsupported expanded title. No Hebrew repair, edition-wide absence or father identity is admitted.
